meta.title: Climate Seen as a Threat
meta.valueLabel: Share calling climate change a threat to their country
meta.method: Weighted by WGT. Share of substantive answers; does not apply, don’t know and refused are left out of the base.
meta.summary: Share who see climate change as a very or somewhat serious threat to their country in the next 20 years. World Risk Poll 2019–2025 (2019 asked about a threat “to people in this country”).
meta.source: World Risk Poll (Lloyd’s Register Foundation / Gallup)
